inter-variable-ui.woff2
  Inter (Rasmus Andersson), gstatic v20, variable weight axis wght 100-900 (opsz at its default, 14)
  A Google Fonts text= subset, so it carries U+2192 (the standard "latin" subset does not):
  css2?family=Inter:wght@100..900&text=<U+0020-007E, U+00A0-00FF, U+2013 U+2014 U+2018 U+2019
    U+201C U+201D U+2022 U+2026 U+2190-2193 U+2122 U+20AC U+2212>
  Google returned these ranges: U+20-7E, U+A0-FF, U+2013-2014, U+2018-2019, U+201C-201D, U+2022,
  U+2026, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2190-2193, U+2212, plus composed Latin letters it added itself.
